script.name: prologue
script.objective: Install the toolchains the example needs, check them and build the example when it is not built.

script.name: t1_gateway_bad_request
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs, send a malformed request for the main.rs:30 branch and one for the main.rs:34 branch; after each record the exit code and whether a second valid request is answered. FAIL if the process exits or aborts; INCONCLUSIVE with its stderr if it does not start.

script.name: t2_slow_connections
script.objective: [H2] Start service-go, open 50 TCP connections, send nothing, wait 60 s and record how many are still open. FAIL if none was closed or if a valid request on a new connection times out; INCONCLUSIVE if it does not start.

script.name: t3_language_builds
script.objective: [H3] Build each example with its own tool: cargo build for rust/core, rust/demo and gateway-rs, go build for go and service-go, dotnet build for csharp and service-cs, the C++ and C compilers for cppcore.cpp and pycore.c. One pass or fail line each, with the compiler error text on a fail; FAIL on any build error.

script.name: t4_binscan
script.objective: [H4] After T3, run tapi_binscan on each built binary, add each missing flag (NX, PIE, RELRO, canary, fortify) to the tapi_cybersec_report and log every binary by name. FAIL on any missing flag.

script.name: t5_egress
script.objective: [EG1] Start gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs, send each a valid request, run tapi_egress with an allowed list of localhost and the contract ports. Every result goes in the tapi_cybersec_report; FAIL names each address outside the list; INCONCLUSIVE with the reason when tapi_egress is unavailable. Kept from round 2; settles no H hypothesis.

script.name: s_rust
script.objective: [smoke] Start gateway-rs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_go
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-go and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cs
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-cs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cpp
script.objective: [smoke] Run dist/bin/cpp-demo once with value=1 hops=1. Checks the exit code is 0 and the output carries "result =". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_c
script.objective: [smoke] dlopen dist/lib/libpycore.so (the C extension) and call its leaf C-ABI function py_weight() once in a child process. Checks the child's exit code is 0 and the value it printed is a finite number. Settles no hypothesis.
